newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM SAYS NO ASSETS EARMARKED FOR DISPOSAL.
newsitem.headline: UPM SAYS NO ASSETS EARMARKED FOR DISPOSAL.

text.p: Finnish forestry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said on Tuesday it had not earmarked any particular assets for disposal to finance its purchase of shares in energy group Kemijoki Oy announced on Tuesday.

"This acquisition will mainly be funded by future disposals of assets ... but we have not earmarked any particular assets," UPM-Kymmene Senior Vice President, Resources, Heikki Sara said by telephone.
UPM-Kymmene said earlier on Tuesday it would buy 6,142 Kemijoki A shares for 476 million markka and that the deal would "improve UPM-Kymmene's power production ownership structure."

In December last year, UPM announced the sale of 1.5 million shares in power group Pohjolan Voima Oy to insurer Ilmarinen for about 500 million markka, reducing its stake in Pohjolan Voima to about 47 percent from 52 percent.
"At that time we sold thermal power (capacity) and now we bought hydropower (capacity)," Sara said. "We did not want to have a majority stake in Pohjolan Voima."
